    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (x u : E) (hu : u ∈ V.carrier)

      η ^ 2 / 2 * ‖g‖ ^ 2

theorem one_step_chain (V : Domain (E := E)) (η : ℕ → ℝ)

      η t * inner ℝ (currentSubgradient (loss t) (iterate V η loss x₁ t))

      (η t) ^ 2 / 2 * ‖currentSubgradient (loss t) (iterate V η loss x₁ t)‖ ^ 2
